<!-- generated by accord skills sync - do not edit - fnv1a64:02e1d5e9fbd24ac7 -->

`/accord-upgrade` upgrades accord, and `/accord upgrade` loads this skill. Follow `./upgrade.md`: it takes the command from the first line of a fresh `accord dashboard` run, and the lines `accord worktree clean` prints are read as `./worktree.md` says.

## Rules

- Anything touching intent, a veto, an acceptance criterion, or a public
  interface stops the run and asks the owner. Every other decision on a
  ticket is a Ruling in `accord/tickets/<id>/ledger.md` under `## Rulings`.
  Read `./ask.md` before any question to the owner.
- `./worktree.md` points to `./failure.md` and `./ids.md`; neither applies to an upgrade.
